Terms of Service

The terms for using our site and taking part in the Best of the City Awards program.

Effective November 13, 2026

These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your use of bestofthecityawards.com (the “Site”) and your participation in the Best of the City Awards program, including nominations, community voting, business spotlights, text messaging and optional media packages (together, the “Program”). The Site and Program are operated by Best of the City Awards (“we,” “us” or “our”).

By using the Site or taking part in the Program, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Site or take part in the Program.

1. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter into a binding agreement to use the Site and take part in the Program. If you act on behalf of a business, you confirm that you are authorized to do so.

2. The Program

Nominations and voting

Nominations and voting are free. Any registered local business can be nominated. Winners are determined by community voting combined with quality checks for fairness and authenticity. You agree to vote honestly and not to use automated tools, fake accounts, purchased votes or any other method to manipulate results. We may review, reject or remove nominations or votes, and disqualify participants, if we believe the rules have been broken. Our decisions on nominations, voting and results are final.

Free Business Spotlight

The Free Business Spotlight is offered at no cost, in limited numbers, and on a first-come, first-served basis in each category. Submitting an application does not guarantee selection. We choose which businesses to feature at our discretion, and we may change, pause or end the offer at any time.

Media packages and paid services

Media packages and other paid services are optional and are covered by the separate agreement or order terms you accept when you buy them. Buying a media package or any other service never affects nominations, votes or results.

Program partners

Some benefits for participating businesses are provided by independent partners. Those partners are responsible for their own products and services, which are subject to their own terms.

3. Information you provide

You agree that the information you submit through our forms or otherwise is accurate and that you have the right to share it. If you nominate a business, you confirm that the information you provide about it is truthful to the best of your knowledge.

This permission is non-exclusive, royalty-free and worldwide, and continues for as long as the content is published.

Unless we agree otherwise in writing, we own the articles, videos, photos and other content we create. You keep ownership of your own trademarks, logos and materials you provide to us, and you confirm you have the right to let us use them. If you would like published content changed or removed, contact us and we will work with you in good faith.

5. Text messaging terms

If you opt in on one of our forms, you agree to receive text messages from Best of the City Awards at the phone number you provided. There are two separate, optional consents: non-marketing messages about your spotlight application, nomination or the Program, and marketing messages such as program news and special offers.

  • Message frequency varies.
  • Message and data rates may apply.
  • Reply STOP to cancel at any time. You will receive one message confirming you have been unsubscribed.
  • Reply HELP for help, or contact us at hi@bestofthecityawards.com or (928) 549-8006.
  • Consent to receive text messages is not a condition of any purchase or of taking part in the Program.
  • Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

See our Privacy Policy for how we handle your phone number and messaging data. No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.
